research_questions: Do action context, participant roles and joint consistency improve correspondence precision and argument maps?
Do independently assessed interfaces enable semantically warranted cross-source solutions on supplied worlds without source-local regressions?
What preservation guarantees and computational costs arise, and how does whole-domain selection affect them?

required: world and goals fixed independently of success
candidate_test_admission.unsupported_intentional_or_epistemic_sem: reject or evaluate in a separately declared setting; do not silently strip

comparability.unsupported_representations: retain as unsupported rows; do not change worlds to force comparability
comparability.source_isolated_cross_source_goal: retain not_representable when appropriate, not solver-unsolvable
comparability.zero_merge_membership: separate encoding control to isolate predicate alignment from representation changes
comparability.budgets: TBD before execution; no run is preregistered by this design document
comparability.initial_only: separate generated-outcome evaluation, never original-goal success

semantic_scoring.reference: two declared-independent judgments, raw files retained; agreement alone is not semantic truth
semantic_scoring.primary_subset: exact label and argument-map consensus excluding uncertain
semantic_scoring.other_rows: missing, disagreement and uncertain retained as separate coverage counts; adjudication separate version
semantic_scoring.failure_policy: invalid, failed and excluded outputs stay in the definite-reference denominator
semantic_scoring.sampling: existing stratified sample supports descriptive sample metrics only; no unweighted population prevalence
semantic_scoring.candidate_generation_recall: requires a separately defined independently labeled candidate universe
semantic_scoring.analysis_unit: source family; do not treat correlated tasks or predicate pairs as independent domains

decision_gates.deliverable: independent labels and frozen test bundle
matched results; choose supported paper scope

do_not_claim: automatic semantic accuracy from format checks
novelty from module flattening or static membership alone
